title: JSOC crash retrievals and Knights of Malta

tellings.quote: According to journalist Seymour Hirsch, one of the modern heads of Joc, General Stanley Mcristel, and many of the members of JOC themselves are all Knights of Malta.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, ties the Joint Special Operations Command, the US military's top command for its elite special forces, to the recovery of crashed craft. He says that, according to the journalist Seymour Hersh, General Stanley McChrystal, a former head of that command, and many of its members belong to the Knights of Malta, an old Catholic religious order. If true, it would mean a religious brotherhood sits close to the people said to handle crash retrievals.
